ai.title: Add MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 to Fireworks API
ai.summary: MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 added to Fireworks API routing in web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts. New entry maps to accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k2p5 with pricing set to $0.60/M input, $0.10/M cached, $3.00/M output. Scope limited to web package; no CLI or desktop changes.

eli5.text: The web app can now use the MoonshotAI Kimi K2.5 assistant as an option, alongside the other assistants you can switch between. It is live today, so you might see it show up in the list of available assistants when picking one. The cost for each usage unit has also been set up behind the scenes, so this new assistant counts as a real, priced option rather than a placeholder.

ai.title: Update eval judge models to GPT-5.4 and Sonnet-4.6
ai.summary: Judge agents in evals/buffbench/judge.ts switched from openai/gpt-5.1 to openai/gpt-5.4 and anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 to anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6. Nightly and main eval runners in evals/buffbench/main-nightly.ts and evals/buffbench/main.ts reduced taskConcurrency from 6 to 5 and 10 to 6 respectively. Changes isolated to internal evaluation infrastructure.

eli5.text: The automated system that scores our internal test results was upgraded to use newer versions of its two main judging models, swapping in GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet-4.6 in place of the previous GPT-5.1 and Sonnet-4.5. Only people running these internal evaluation jobs will see any difference: the latest scoring results will now be produced by the new models instead of the old ones. Along with the model swap, the two nightly scoring jobs now cap how many tests they run at the same time to a slightly lower number, so they will pace themselves a little more conservatively. These changes are live today for anyone running the internal test harnesses.
